introduction_markdown: Duration: two and a half hours. This paper is arranged in two sections, A and B. Answer ALL questions in Sections A and B. Section A: answer ALL 15 questions in the spaces provided; the mark allocation for each question is indicated. Section B: answer ALL four questions; all questions in Section B carry equal marks (15 marks each). You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Calculators are allowed.

questions.corrige_markdown:
Add $2$ to every part: $-7 + 2 < 5x \le 3 + 2$, that is $-5 < 5x \le 5$.

Divide every part by $5$ (positive, so the inequality signs do not change): $-1 < x \le 1$.

**Answer: $-1 < x \le 1$.**

questions.enonce_markdown: Represent the solution of (a) on a real number line.
questions.corrige_markdown:
Draw a horizontal number line marked at least from $-2$ to $2$.

- At $x = -1$ draw an **open circle** (the value $-1$ is not included, strict inequality $<$).
- At $x = 1$ draw a **closed (filled) circle** (the value $1$ is included, $\le$).
- Draw a thick line joining the two circles: it represents all real numbers $x$ with $-1 < x \le 1$.
